quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings press release: Consolidated Financial Result Digest FY2027/3 1Q (Fiscal (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics first quarter (April-June 2026) drivers per the company's results digest: net sales rose 26% YoY on continued yen depreciation (average rate 160.5 JPY/USD vs 145.2 a year earlier) and higher sales volume of PKG (semiconductor package) and rigid products. PKG products: continued demand growth driven by AI adoption, with sales volume up mainly for dry film products for memory applications. Rigid products: sales volume up mainly for automotive and high-density interconnect (HDI) applications; sales volume of display (white dry film) products decreased. In response to rising raw material and other expenses, prices of certain products were revised for shipments from June onward. Electronics operating income margin 35% (28% a year earlier); Electronics EBITDA JPY 10,725 million (+51%).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics net sales +26% YoY; operating income margin 35% (28% a year earlier); average 160.5 JPY/USD vs 145.2

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings press release: Consolidated Financial Result Digest FY2027/3 1Q (Fiscal (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medical and Pharmaceuticals first quarter (April-June 2026) per the company's results digest: net sales decreased 2% YoY (operating income -44%) on lower sales volume in the manufacturing and marketing business, where demand for cough suppressants and expectorants fell, supply shortages of drugs with the same indications at other companies were resolved, and volume fell for items subject to the elective care scheme; in the contract manufacturing business, contract volume from existing customers increased and the product mix improved. ICT and Sustainability net sales JPY 1,766 million (+16%).
quarterly_data.figure: Medical and Pharmaceuticals net sales -2% YoY; operating income -44%
